title: Collatz: actual boundary laws, entropy, and complete source cuts
body:
## Status

**Collatz remains OPEN.** This draft PR preserves a cumulative research branch. The latest checkpoint directly tests three proposed ways to close the actual-source step; it does not claim universal descent, escape exclusion, or exclusion of nontrivial positive cycles.

## Latest checkpoint — 23 November 2026

Published head: `04572b94c8a58f964ba9b2b1b1bccfe7e9b12ae2`  
Tree: `76137dd34004af2188992e0412ed172c46326653`  
Parent: `5e29f56f6d44669a8aa9134e5617b78d65c074c2`.

**[Start with the research summary](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/04572b94c8a58f964ba9b2b1b1bccfe7e9b12ae2/research/high-variance-20261123/README.md).** The update adds 25 files. It builds on the latest inspected PR175, 176, 177, 178 and 185 heads and the existing canonical construction, retaining their source qualifications. [Exact inspected source pins](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/04572b94c8a58f964ba9b2b1b1bccfe7e9b12ae2/research/high-variance-20261123/SOURCES.json) and [literature use](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/04572b94c8a58f964ba9b2b1b1bccfe7e9b12ae2/research/high-variance-20261123/LITERATURE.json) distinguish imported statements from new deductions.

### What this pass changes

1. **The actual component, inverse real fibre and canonical charge now share one exact representation.** A coherent ordinary coordinate gives a common real boundary variable Z on the actual two-sided path law. The G-inverse fibre is exactly the Z-size bias, and its reciprocal moment reconstructs the normalized component charge. The strict variance identity is explicit. PR178's distinct trace fibre retains its additional bounded positive tilt. Under the separately qualified Paper 37 v4 routing count, the common boundary support has Hausdorff dimension one. This is a support theorem, not a canonical-measure dimension theorem. The coherent analytic deformation has an explicit fractional-linear boundary and only the original parameter can remain integral along an entire forward orbit. [Proof](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/04572b94c8a58f964ba9b2b1b1bccfe7e9b12ae2/research/high-variance-20261123/ANALYTIC_GLUING.md).

2. **The entropy comparison retains the original probability law and clock.** Conditioning the actual whole-path law through a uniformly sampled forward vertex has exact relative entropy equal to the average of log(c_E/nu(q_j)), tending to zero. Thus the common boundary decouples from every observation of that same time label, even at moving digit resolutions. A separate fixed-root argument gives vanishing maximum complete-word mass, divergent word entropy and a nonatomic path law, without a rate or a real-pushforward conclusion. Obtaining the moving ordinary fibre from the bulk joint affine law instead costs at least k log(2)-O(1), or k log(4/3)-O(1) after conditioning on the real shell. The physical fibre's root-dependent rescaling remains explicit. [Proof](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/04572b94c8a58f964ba9b2b1b1bccfe7e9b12ae2/research/high-variance-20261123/ENTROPY_RIGIDITY.md).

3. **The source replacement uses an entire inverse language of unlimited length.** Deleting a supplied prefix containing a gap four funds every actual gap-one-through-three word ending at the unchanged cut, with a new initial exponent at most three. A genuine joint bad query therefore forces its whole cluster below the original target bound. Exact finite-tree counting, height and harmonic-flow boundary identities are proved. An unrestricted coercivity proposal fails on an all-length family of complete certificates. The complete bounded-four/two-four control has 1371 sources and a true minimum-grade, maximum-source interval at t=2^51-1; the cut through 37→7 still yields only powered source 72. That target descends at shortcut time 138 and reaches one at 384, so no badness is claimed. [Proof](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/04572b94c8a58f964ba9b2b1b1bccfe7e9b12ae2/research/high-variance-20261123/GLOBAL_SOURCE_SYNTHESIS.md) · [Exact checker](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/04572b94c8a58f964ba9b2b1b1bccfe7e9b12ae2/research/high-variance-20261123/check_global_source.py).

4. **Two new finite Lean declarations check the algebra used by the fibre representation.** They prove the coherent-edge increment and finite normalization, reciprocal moment and variance identities. The finite reconstruction allows signed weights; probability interpretation separately requires positivity. Infinite measure construction and external analytic inputs are not encoded as axioms. [Lean source](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/04572b94c8a58f964ba9b2b1b1bccfe7e9b12ae2/research/high-variance-20261123/lean/FibreReconstruction.lean) · [Public inventory](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/04572b94c8a58f964ba9b2b1b1bccfe7e9b12ae2/research/high-variance-20261123/THEOREMS.json).

### Actual validation

- Fresh Lean 4.34.1 compilation of only the two new modules, warnings as errors; all two public declarations audited, with only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. Pinned compiler commit 5045d0056413266e57c625dcd7c365b10e377c52 and Mathlib d13f23b723b8a846827a245b89c10fc7d3f11612. Installed dependency objects reused; historical project proofs were not rebuilt.
- Exact integer control passed normal and optimized Python with byte-identical frozen JSON. Every reported inverse closure is complete; guards abort instead of certifying a censored search.
- All three written notes and the finite Lean algebra received independent in-session reconstruction reviews, with exact final hashes and stated upstream limits. Final whitespace/TeX-spacing cleanup is explicitly carried forward in the bindings.
- The required `python -X utf8 -B tools/validate.py` passed all five default commands on a clean complete local checkout, then passed again on the **fetched published commit above**, with 547 tracked files and the exact tree above.
- On that fetched commit, all 24 manifest-listed file hashes, four proof/review bindings, both compiled-source identities, JSON and relative links passed. The manifest itself is included as the 25th added file. The complete checkout remained clean.
- The remote PR head was read back at the published SHA. Repository integrity, exact finite execution, finite Lean proofs and source-qualified infinite arguments remain distinct evidence levels.

[Verification scope and execution records](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/04572b94c8a58f964ba9b2b1b1bccfe7e9b12ae2/reports/2026-11-23-high-variance/VERIFICATION.md) · [Exact file manifest](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/04572b94c8a58f964ba9b2b1b1bccfe7e9b12ae2/reports/2026-11-23-high-variance/FILES.json) · [Review bindings](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/04572b94c8a58f964ba9b2b1b1bccfe7e9b12ae2/reports/2026-11-23-high-variance/REVIEW_SCOPE.json).

### Remaining closing step

The dimension-one support and fixed-root nonatomic path law do not establish the canonical entropy lower bound at moving roots. The finite routing comparison still contains log(q*nu(q)/gamma), and the bulk-fibre conditioning retains a linear clock cost. A same-root estimate early enough to remove that cost, or a successful legal descent of the original target using its actual badness information, is still missing. None is assumed in the claimed deductions.

The full published-checkout integrity receipt was generated outside the tested checkout. Its SHA256 is `f1f4cb5d957ffc12cf2a3451bc035202106de0200b94f1bd4bca3311e99a9bdf`; all five command exit codes were zero and the checkout identity was unchanged. The optional historical regression bundle was not run.

## Current checkpoint: attacks on the retained ordinary source

**Full Collatz remains OPEN.** This continuation used three parallel researchers plus the principal researcher to pursue actual source descent, the source-retaining sibling bound, and zero canonical escape charge. It adds concrete written deductions and records where the attempted closing arguments stop. No universal descent, escape-exclusion, or nontrivial-cycle theorem was obtained.

## 1. Use all of the modular-routing mass

The latest version 4 of the pointwise modular-routing manuscript supplies a multiplicity of actual legal words at one common length and total valuation. Consuming that multiplicity gives, for every nonnegative function f of k ternary digits,

```text
P^b f(x) >= (2c / (3 sqrt(b))) * average_unit(f)
b = O_epsilon((k+1)^(1+epsilon))
```

at every positive odd ordinary unit x. P keeps the actual critical weight 3/2^e. The count cancels the exponential cost of selecting a single route. The note also constructs a legal transplant of a whole finite stopping antichain, with explicit replacement sources and collision accounting.

The input count remains source-qualified: its external stopped-renewal and fine joint-mixing analytic chain was not re-audited or formally replayed. Retaining one specified depth-r spike still costs 3^(-r-1). The existing density/floor inputs imply uniformly bounded Haar means of the finite Bellman obstacles; broadening a high ordinary spike into a large residue fraction is therefore not justified. OPEN-F and OPEN-S remain unproved.

[Weighted routing and attempted closure](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/5e29f56f6d44669a8aa9134e5617b78d65c074c2/research/retained-source-attacks-20261122/SIBLING_MASS.md) · [Independent review](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/5e29f56f6d44669a8aa9134e5617b78d65c074c2/research/retained-source-attacks-20261122/REVIEW_SIBLING_MASS.md)

## 2. Exact nonlinear entropy for the canonical current

On a hypothetical escaping component E, write c_E for stationary clock-layer mass, D_E for total canonical source charge and F_E=D_E/c_E. For the actual inverse kernels K and K_h, the new exact budget is

```text
sum_(q in E) nu(q) KL(K(q,·) || K_h(q,·))
  = sum_(q in E) nu(q) log(1 + 1/(3q)) + c_E log(1-F_E).
```

The sum is finite. The signed telescope retains both clock boundaries and uses the pinned absolute canonical edge-variation input. The same quantity is the relative entropy of an explicit tilt of a probability law on two-sided actual ordinary paths. It gives a nonlinear restriction on F_E, but does not force F_E=0.

[Canonical entropy and whole-path proof](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/5e29f56f6d44669a8aa9134e5617b78d65c074c2/research/retained-source-attacks-20261122/CANONICAL_CHARGE.md) · [Independent review](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/5e29f56f6d44669a8aa9134e5617b78d65c074c2/research/retained-source-attacks-20261122/REVIEW_CANONICAL_CHARGE.md)

## 3. Follow the entire-function idea through its actual boundary

The actual path-count bound sharpens the strict-Green inverse to entire order at most theta=39/40:

```text
||(I+z K_strict)^(-1)|| <= 1 + |z| A_s exp(B_theta |z|^theta).
```

A nonconstant positive Laplace transform cannot be entire with that subexponential growth. We tried to apply this rigidity to the surviving canonical flow.

The entire linear family fails the positive-Laplace moment test already on an unchanged ordinary source: its literal product J has J(0)J''(0)-J'(0)^2 = -sum_j (3q_j+1)^(-2) < 0. The all-positive physical family with factors 3q/(3q+z) has the required Laplace representation, but its component boundary B_E has a nonremovable simple pole. At the least ordinary state m=min E,

```text
Res_(z=-3m) B_E(z) >= 3m nu(m) > 0.
```

The proof excludes cancellation of this pole after taking the actual canonical mixture and boundary limit. The two parameter families agree at one; their analytic continuations cannot be identified. The proposed closing contradiction therefore fails at a precise, proved interface.

[Entire-order and unchanged-source calculation](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/5e29f56f6d44669a8aa9134e5617b78d65c074c2/research/retained-source-attacks-20261122/ANALYTIC_PARAMETER.md) · [Independent review](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/5e29f56f6d44669a8aa9134e5617b78d65c074c2/research/retained-source-attacks-20261122/REVIEW_ANALYTIC_PARAMETER.md)

## 4. Nonlocal surgery of the complete supplied source

The arithmetic lane retained the full joint least-target/minimum-grade/largest-source hypotheses. Deleting an arbitrarily long interior window, while keeping an actual prefix of odd depth i and ordinary clock E, requires

```text
q' = q + 2^E (v-u) / 3^i; integrality iff 3^i divides v-u.
```

This yields a residue-record restriction on the joint source. An all-length gap-four replacement attempt fails at endpoints 7 mod 9, where the entire inverse language with gaps at most three has only the empty word and [2]. Allowing changes through every earlier gap gives an exact propagated carry, but while the power remains nonnegative a positive carry stays positive. The smaller powered source still needs the original target-interval slack to pay that carry.

No simultaneous multiwindow cancellation or successful original-target merger was constructed. These calculations are an exact account of the direct attempt, not a universal impossibility claim for source surgery.

[Nonlocal source attack](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/5e29f56f6d44669a8aa9134e5617b78d65c074c2/research/retained-source-attacks-20261122/LEGAL_DESCENT.md) · [Independent review](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/5e29f56f6d44669a8aa9134e5617b78d65c074c2/research/retained-source-attacks-20261122/REVIEW_LEGAL_DESCENT.md)
